newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-KASHIMA ANTLERS CONTINUE J-LEAGUE STREAK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KASHIMA ANTLERS CONTINUE J-LEAGUE STREAK.

text.p: J-League first-stage champion Kashima Antlers beat host Vissel Kobe 5-0 on Saturday for their second straight win in the second stage.
Hisashi Kurosaki scored twice and substitute Atsushi Yanagisawa scored for the second straight game as the Antlers chalked up a leaguee record 10th straight away match win.
JEF United Ichihara spoiled the return of Brazilian forward Alcindo Sartori to Verdy Kawasaki and handed them a fifth straight loss with a 3-1 home victory.
Alcindo, who rejoined the team last month from Brazilian club Fluminense, scored a late goal, his 70th in the J-League.
Cameroon forward Patrick Mboma netted two goals in the final five minutes, an 87th minute equalizer and the winner only a minute later, to give Gamba Osaka a 3-2 victory at Hiratsuka.
First-stage runners-up Yokohama Flugels edged host Fukuoka 1-0 on Brazilian Valber's extra-time winner.
At Hiroshima, Masashi Nakayama scored once in each half to help Iwata beat Hiroshima 3-1. Hiroshima's international striker Takuya Takagi collected his 50th career league goal on a penalty shot.
League-leading scorer Edilson notched his 17th goal of the season in extra time to earn Kashiwa two points with a 3-2 win at Shimizu.
Spanish forward Aitor Beguiristain's scored his first goal in Japan to boost Urawa to a 2-0 win over Yokohama Marinos.
Takashi Hirano powered Nagoya to a 3-2 win over Cerezo Osaka 3-2.
